subject: general
question: Where did the induction program for the first batch of 80 personnel for Telangana’s Tourism Police units take place?

options.text: National Institute of Tourism and Hospitality Management (NITHM)

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Institute of Tourism and Hospitality Management (NITHM).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Telangana state launched its dedicated Tourism Police units, with the induction program for the first batch of 80 personnel starting at the National Institute of Tourism and Hospitality Management (NITHM) in Hyderabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The week-long induction program aims to build capacity, improve visitor facilitation, and strengthen the tourism ecosystem in Telangana.**
 
• **The Tourism Police personnel will be deployed at major tourist destinations across nine Police Commissionerates in Telangana, including Somasila, Ananthagiri, Ramappa, Yadagirigutta, and others.**
 
• **Additional Director General of Police, Mahesh Bhagwat, highlighted the joint effort between the Police Department and the Tourism and Culture Department to ensure safety and hospitality.**
 
• **The initiative underscores Telangana’s goal to project a positive image globally through skilled, visitor-friendly personnel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tourism Police Units__

 __
 
• A special police unit designed to ensure safety and provide assistance to tourists, improving overall tourism experiences in the state.
 
 
 
• NITHM__
 __
 
• A premier institute in Hyderabad focusing on tourism and hospitality management, where the induction program for the Tourism Police was conducted.
 
 
 
• Mahesh Bhagwat__
 
 
• Additional Director General of Police (Law & Order), who emphasized the collaboration between various departments for enhancing tourism safety.
